notes: Issuer tender offer by a BDC ('We have elected to be regulated as a business development company') for its own 4.95% Senior Convertible Notes due 2022, not common shares; classed cef_tender with security_class notes. Size is stated as up to $60,000,000 aggregate principal amount of $111,055,000 outstanding (as of August 25, 2021); size_shares left null because the filing gives a principal amount, not a count, and size_pct_outstanding left null because it would need arithmetic. Price is fixed at $1,025.00 per $1,000 principal amount plus accrued interest (not per share, so final_price_per_share null; this is the offer document, so no results). Expiration stated as 12:00 midnight NYC time on September 24, 2021 (one minute after 11:59 p.m. on September 23, 2021); 2021-09-24 is the date as written. subject_tickers: PSEC is the common stock ticker printed in the filing; the Notes themselves are stated to be unlisted. Conditions are the 'General Conditions' (litigation/injunction, market suspension or banking moratorium or war, material adverse change, trustee objection, competing tender or merger proposal); not conditioned on a minimum tender; funding expected from the Credit Facility but not stated as a condition. The Company may also terminate in its sole discretion (not coded as board_discretion). trigger_origin: the stated purpose is to reduce outstanding Notes (company-initiated liability management), coded board_discretionary.
